description:
`runs/agent/v1` at `/agents/<id>`: a subagent a session started, written once when it started.

The prompt it was started with is beside it as `<id>.md`. `session` is the
session that started it and `cwd` the directory it runs in. `works_on`
references the change it works on, when the prompt's last line or the
session's one held change names it. A run whose `agent` names this record
says the subagent stopped; until one does, it is running.

cwd.description: The directory the subagent runs in, absolute.

session.description: The session that started the subagent.

started.description: When the subagent started, with a time zone.

works_on.description: The change the subagent works on, such as /changes/suite-timeout.

written_by.description: The plugin and hook that wrote this record, such as runs/subagent-stop; absent when an agent or a person wrote it.

title: AgentRecord
